ideas.title: The Challenge
ideas.angle: A food blogger attempts to create the ultimate cheesiest veg burger, showcasing the cheese pull.

ideas.title: The Prep
ideas.angle: Close-up of patty construction: layering, pressing, ensuring maximum cheese coverage.

ideas.title: The Cook
ideas.angle: Burger sizzling on the grill, cheese visibly melting and bubbling.

ideas.title: The Attempt
ideas.angle: First pull fails - cheese breaks, patty falls apart. Frustration visible.

ideas.title: The Triumph
ideas.angle: Second attempt: perfect pull, long glossy cheese stretch, ecstatic reaction.
